# Slovenia

> Benchmark chips for Slovenia cut from the harmonized field boundary collection for Slovenia (edition 2024).

- [Collection](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/si/collection.json)
- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/si/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/si/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/si/si_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/si/si_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/si/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/si/si_fields.parquet)
- [Field boundaries (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/si/fields.pmtiles)
- [STAC items in GeoParquet format (collection mirror)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/si/items.parquet)
